reason: We lost our renderer and I need someone reliable, and a free first plan with no deposit means I only risk my time. If the first one matches our plans, I'd pay for it and probably start rolling out the library.
objection: Will it actually match our plans, or will it show finishes and options we won't build? A buyer who walks a wrong version becomes my problem, not yours.
would_change_my_mind: A free test on one of our own plans where my drafter checks it against the set and it matches, plus an example from another Utah builder.
